TITLE: MCP servers
subtitle: External tool servers (Model Context Protocol) whose tools the chat assistant may use.
egress: The server's address must be on the egress allowlist (exit/Caddyfile and extra_hosts) — an infrastructure change, see docs/markdown/en/operations.md. Otherwise the test ends with a connection error.
emptyText: Add a server, e.g. an EU compliance database, so the assistant can use its tools.
loadError: The MCP servers could not be loaded
noTools: No tools yet — run the test.
addressRefused: The address of “{name}” is no longer allowed — edit it first.
deleteText: The assistant can no longer use this server's tools. The header values are deleted.

FORM.name: Name
FORM.nameHint: 2–31 characters: lowercase letters, digits and _, starting with a letter
FORM.nameInvalid: The name does not match the format
FORM.urlHint: The https:// address of a public server (its DNS name, the standard port)
FORM.urlTooLong: The address is too long (at most 500 characters)
FORM.urlNotHttps: The address must start with https://
FORM.urlPort: Leave out the port — only the standard https port (443) is reachable
FORM.urlCredentials: Do not put user:password in the address — add the credentials as a header
FORM.urlAddress: Use the server's DNS name, not an IP address
FORM.urlInternal: Use a public server — not a container, localhost or a local name (.local, .internal …)
FORM.headerInvalid: Header name: letters, digits and hyphens
FORM.headerValueMissing: Enter the header's value, or remove the row
FORM.allowedHint: Empty — every tool of the server is allowed. Type and press Enter.
FORM.newDisabled: A new server is created disabled until you test it.
